The crash is the same scene, just cheaper to run. `index.html` still auto-plays the default impact on load.

- Physics stays at 1/120. Solver is 8 / 2 / 1, and a frame does at most 4 steps. Glass is 14 shards instead of 28, with the same mass. Bricks no longer use CCD or contact-force events. Curb and rail colliders are gone. After the wreck settles, contact events turn off.
- Shadows are a 1024 PCF map, radius 2, tight on the car and wall, and they stop updating once the pile is still. Only the car hulls, tires, and bricks cast. Spot and point lights are gone.
- The car is merged to one draw per body per material. Posts, poles, trees, and skids are instanced. Glass is a cheap transparent material. Bloom and MSAA are gone. SSAO stays, at half resolution with a smaller kernel, so the contact darkening is still there. Pixel ratio is 1.
